subject: [PATCH v3 2/2] scsi: mpt3sas: Time out delayed not-responding device blocks

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch addresses a deadlock issue in the mpt3sas driver by introducing a delayed work queue to unblock devices that have been marked as not responding after a certain delay. The patch also takes into account both SAS and PCIe device missing delays, and ensures that offline devices are not timed-blocked. This fix is necessary because the previous partial solution did not address all scenarios, particularly when LUN 0 may be blocked before or during a scan.
